ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Base64 Decoded From Images
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of tail to extract bytes at an offset from an image and then decode the base64 value to create a new file with the decoded content. The detected execution is a bash one-liner.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/bash$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*tail.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-c.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*base64.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-d.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.avif.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.gif.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jfif.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jpeg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jpg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pjp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pjpeg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.png.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.svg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.webp.*")))
